name: local-voice-agent
description: Local real-time voice + web AI assistant

scripts.dev: npm run dev:backend & npm run dev:desktop
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/backend && npm run build -w apps/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/backend && npm run typecheck -w apps/desktop
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules apps/*/dist packages/*/dist
